title: Go Budget (2024)
description: GoBudget is a personal monthly budget planner I made with my friend: log your income and up to four expenses and get a live allocation breakdown, totals, and an over-budget warning — saved per-user to Supabase.

title: Barangay Together
description: This is a PHP + Supabase web app that lets barangay officials post volunteer activities and residents sign up, with role-based accounts, slot limits, and participation tracking.

title: Omaclippr - Plugin for Omarchy
description: Background instant replay buffer to capture your best gaming moments and desktop highlights on demand.

title: Palworld Dedicated Server using Google VPS
description: Administered the server via an Ubuntu/Debian headless environment using systemd services and automated shell scripts for scheduled restarts, backups, and memory management.

title: Flappy Bird Clone (Godot Engine)
description: Developed a Flappy Bird clone featuring custom physics, precise collision detection, and an intuitive UI to recreate smooth, responsive gameplay.

title: Been Here Before (Godot Engine)
description: Built an immersive 2D psychological horror title inspired by The Exit 8 as part of a game jam team, providing hands-on experience in cooperative design and execution under tight deadlines.
